text:
Alex: Hey team — starting my first PR against infra-service. Quick q: what's our preferred PR workflow, commit msg format, and who usually reviews infra changes?
Olivia: Welcome! For infra-service: branch = feat/<ticket-number>-short-desc. Draft your PR, add the ticket link, and mark it with labels: needs-review, infra.
Olivia: We prefer squash-and-merge for features, keep PRs < 500 LOC ideally. If it's large, open an RFC or split into multiple PRs.
Sarah: Also run pre-commit and unit tests locally before pushing: `pre-commit run --all-files` and `./scripts/run_tests.sh` (or `pytest -k <module>` for quick runs).
Matt: If you hit flakiness, try `pytest -k 'your_test' -q -x` and rerun the failing test. For linting: `pre-commit run --all-files` or `pre-commit run --hook-stage commit` pre-push.
Olivia: For reviewers — check CODEOWNERS first. If no owner, ping @engineering-infra or tag `@matt` for infra touch.
Alex: What's our commit message template?
Olivia: We use a conventional-ish style. Example:
```
feat(infra): add healthcheck to gpu-autoscaler

Fixes: RED-1234
Summary: short one-line summary
```
Sarah: Add a test matrix entry if you change CI config. For a quick smoke: `./scripts/ci_local.sh` to run the same steps as CI runs (fast mode available with `--fast`).
Matt: To rebase: `git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main --autostash`. Resolve conflicts, run tests, then `git push --force-with-lease`.
Alex: Who should I request for review? any specific rubric?
Olivia: Request 2 approvals: one from CODEOWNERS and one cross-team reviewer. Focus reviewers on design, tests, perf, and API compatibility.
Olivia: Add this checklist to your PR description: change summary, migration notes, perf implications, testing steps, rollback plan, risk level.
Alex: Any tips for CI debugging? I saw a flaky linux-test.
Sarah: Look at the GitHub Actions logs, filter by `::error`/`::warning`. Re-run the job from Actions UI. If it's flaky across runs, tag `@eng-oncall` and include the failing test id.
CI Bot: tests/checks — all required checks passed (build #7123) :white_check_mark: https://ci.redwood.example/7123
Olivia: Small PRs get faster review. If you're blocked ping me directly or drop in #devex.
Alex: Thanks! I'll open a draft with the label `needs-review` when ready. :thumbsup:
Matt: One more: avoid adding large binary blobs to the repo; use git-lfs and mention in the PR description if you must.
Sarah: Also prefer fixing pre-commit failures instead of `git commit --no-verify`.
Olivia: Welcome aboard again — happy to pair-review your first PR. :party:
Alex: Appreciate it, tagging you in the draft in a bit.
